newsitem.title: USA: BI Inc acquires patent from CAE Inc.
newsitem.headline: BI Inc acquires patent from CAE Inc.

text.p: BI Inc said it acquired from CAE Inc a patent that includes "tracking" technologies such as geolocation and telecommunications capabilities.
BI said will use the acquired technology specifically for the corrections industry.

"Understandably, the corrections environment presents a challenging application for full time tracking of individuals. We will offer this technology to our customers only after it's been thoroughly tested and proven reliable for application in a community corrections setting," said Mckinley Edwards Jr, BI's chief operating officer.
BI provides electronic monitoring equipment and services, corrections information systems and community correctional services to the criminal justice market worldwide.
